```{r}
# Get chromosome lengths for standard chromosomes only
seqinfo_hg38 <- seqlengths(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
std_chroms <- grepl("^chr([1-9]|1[0-9]|2[0-2]|X|Y|M)$", names(seqinfo_hg38))
seqinfo_hg38 <- seqinfo_hg38[std_chroms]

# Tile into 500 bp non-overlapping windows
tiles_500bp <- GenomicRanges::tileGenome(seqinfo_hg38, tilewidth = 500, cut.last.tile.in.chrom = TRUE)

# Add a tile number column
tiles_500bp <- tiles_500bp %>%
  data.frame() %>%
  mutate(tile_num = 1:n()) %>%
  as_granges()

# cpgs
seqs <- c(seqnames(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38::BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)[1:22], "chrX", "chrY")

cg_sites <- lapply(seqs, function(x) {
  cbind(data.frame(Biostrings::matchPattern("CG", BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38::BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38[[x]])),
        seqnames = x
  )}) %>% bind_rows()

tiles_500bp_cg <- find_overlaps(tiles_500bp, as_granges(cg_sites)) %>% data.frame() %>%
  group_by(tile_num) %>% mutate(n_cg = n())
tiles_500bp_cg <- tiles_500bp_cg %>% ungroup() %>% distinct()

tiles_500bp_cg$tile_id <- paste0(tiles_500bp_cg$seqnames, ":", tiles_500bp_cg$start, "-", tiles_500bp_cg$end)

tiles_500bp_cg
```

```{r}
reads_chr <- function(read_data_path_a, tiles,
                       jit_amount = 0.1) {
  set.seed(42)

  # ── 1. Read only the matching rows — never loads unmatched data into RAM ───
  con <- dbConnect(duckdb())
  on.exit(dbDisconnect(con))
  
  tiles_df <- as.data.frame(tiles)[, c("seqnames", "start", "end", "tile_id")]
  tiles_df$seqnames <- as.character(tiles_df$seqnames)
  duckdb_register(con, "tiles", tiles_df)
  
  overlap_query <- function(path) {
    dbGetQuery(con, glue::glue("
      SELECT DISTINCT r.*, t.tile_id
      FROM read_parquet('{path}') r
      JOIN tiles t
        ON r.seqnames = t.seqnames
       AND r.start >= t.start
       AND r.end   <= t.end
    "))
  }
  
  
  read_data <- overlap_query(read_data_path_a)

  
  read_data$type <- "healthy"

  read_data <- read_data %>% mutate(alpha_group = case_when(alpha < 0.2 ~ "a < 0.2",
                                 alpha > 0.8 ~ "a > 0.8",
                                 alpha >= 0.2 & alpha <= 0.4 ~ "0.2 <= a <= 0.4",
                                 alpha > 0.4 & alpha < 0.6 ~ "0.4 < a < 0.6",
                                 TRUE ~ "0.6 <= a <= 0.8"))
  read_data <- read_data %>% mutate(alpha_group = factor(alpha_group, levels = c("a < 0.2", "0.2 <= a <= 0.4", "0.4 < a < 0.6", "0.6 <= a <= 0.8", "a > 0.8")))
#  read_data <- read_data %>% count(type, region_id, alpha_group, name = "tile_band_count") %>% group_by(region_id, type) %>% mutate(percent = tile_band_count/sum(tile_band_count)) %>% ungroup()
  sample_names <- unique(read_data$sample)
  read_data <- read_data %>% filter(total >= 3) %>% 
    mutate(transcript = paste0(region_id, "_", alpha_group)) %>%
  group_by(sample, transcript) %>%
  summarise(transcript_count = n()) %>% ungroup() %>% data.frame()
  
  read_data <- read_data %>% pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = transcript_count)
  read_data[is.na(read_data)] <- 0
  read_data$gene_id <- sub("_.*", "", read_data$transcript)
  
  c(read_data, sample_names)
}
```

```{r}
betas_for_wgbs <- function(reads) {
  # Split entire columns at once (vectorised, not row-wise)
  meth_split <- strsplit(reads$meth_pattern, "")
  pos_split  <- lapply(strsplit(reads$genom_positions, ","), as.double)
  n          <- lengths(meth_split)   # CpGs per read

  # Unnest with rep/unlist — much faster than tidyr::unnest
  dt <- data.table(
    sample      = rep(reads$sample,   n),
    seqnames    = rep(reads$seqnames, n),
    start       = unlist(pos_split,   use.names = FALSE),
    meth_status = unlist(meth_split,  use.names = FALSE)
  )

  # Count M/U and compute beta in one grouped pass
  result <- dt[, {
    m <- sum(meth_status == "M")
    u <- sum(meth_status == "U")
    list(meth_count_pos = m, unmeth_count_pos = u, beta = m / (m + u))
  }, keyby = .(sample, seqnames, start)]

  # Collapse across samples (matches original behaviour)
  unique(result[, .(sample, seqnames, start, meth_count_pos, unmeth_count_pos, beta)])
}
```

```{r}
process_wgbs_short <- function(bismark, bed = NULL) {
  read <- bismark
  names(read) <- c("read_id", "strand", "seqnames", "start", "meth_status")
  read$end <- read$start

  read_overlap <- read
  read_overlap[, meth_status := ifelse(meth_status == "Z", "M", "U")]
  read_overlap[, meth_pattern := paste0(meth_status, collapse = ""), by = read_id]
  read_overlap[, num_meth := str_count(meth_pattern, pattern = "M")]
  read_overlap[, total := str_length(meth_pattern)]
  read_overlap[, alpha := num_meth/total]
  read_overlap[, genom_positions := paste0(start, collapse = ","), by = read_id]

  read_overlap <- read_overlap %>% .[order(.$read_id),]

  read_overlap[, read_start := min(start), by = read_id]
  read_overlap[, read_end := max(start), by = read_id]

  read_overlap
}
```

```{r}
ds <- diffSpliceDGE(fit, coef = 2, geneid = "gene_id", exonid = "transcript")
ts.gene_optiles <- topSpliceDGE(ds, test = "exon", number = Inf)


ts.gene_optiles <- ts.gene_optiles %>%
  mutate(region_id = gene_id) %>%
  separate_wider_delim(gene_id, delim = ":", names = c("seqnames", "gene_id")) %>%
  mutate(seqnames = gsub("chrchr", "chr", seqnames)) %>%
  separate_wider_delim(gene_id, delim = "-", names = c("start", "end"))
ts.gene_optiles$start <- as.double(ts.gene_optiles$start)
ts.gene_optiles$end <- as.double(ts.gene_optiles$end)
ts.gene_optiles$dtu_rank <- 1:nrow(ts.gene_optiles)
saveRDS(ts.gene_optiles, "/researchers/caitlin.page/cf_nano/r_output/dtu_basictiles_emseq_healthy_sex_aband.rds")
```

```{r}
rrbs_plot5_sex <- function(read_data_path_a, read_data_path_b, chrom, region_start, region_end, facet_by = "group",
                       jit_amount = 0.1) {
  set.seed(42)

  # ── 1. Read only the matching rows — never loads unmatched data into RAM ───
  con <- dbConnect(duckdb())
  on.exit(dbDisconnect(con))
  
  read_data_a <- dbGetQuery(con, glue::glue("
    SELECT *
    FROM read_parquet('{read_data_path_a}')
    WHERE seqnames = '{chrom}'
      AND \"start\" >= {region_start}
      AND \"end\"   <= {region_end}
  "))
  
  read_data_b <- dbGetQuery(con, glue::glue("
    SELECT *
    FROM read_parquet('{read_data_path_b}')
    WHERE seqnames = '{chrom}'
      AND \"start\" >= {region_start}
      AND \"end\"   <= {region_end}
  "))
  
  read_data_a <- read_data_a %>% 
  mutate(sample = case_when(sample == "a1" ~ "healthy_785",
                            sample == "a2" ~ "healthy_036",
                            sample == "a3" ~ "healthy_787",
                            sample == "b1" ~ "healthy_786",
                            sample == "b2" ~ "healthy_037",
                            TRUE ~ "healthy_789")) %>%
    mutate(sex = ifelse(sample %in% c("healthy_036", "healthy_037"), "male", "female"))
  read_data_b$sex <- "female"
  
  read_data <- rbind(read_data_a, read_data_b)
  
  jitter_amount <- runif(nrow(read_data), -jit_amount, jit_amount)
  read_data$alpha_jit <- read_data$alpha + jitter_amount
  read_data <- data.frame(read_data)
  
  read_data <- read_data %>% mutate(alpha_group = case_when(alpha < 0.2 ~ "a < 0.2",
                                 alpha > 0.8 ~ "a > 0.8",
                                 alpha >= 0.2 & alpha <= 0.4 ~ "0.2 <= a <= 0.4",
                                 alpha > 0.4 & alpha < 0.6 ~ "0.4 < a < 0.6",
                                 TRUE ~ "0.6 <= a <= 0.8"))
  read_data <- read_data %>% mutate(alpha_group = factor(alpha_group, levels = c("a < 0.2", "0.2 <= a <= 0.4", "0.4 < a < 0.6", "0.6 <= a <= 0.8", "a > 0.8")))
  
  # Add jittered coordinates to new columns in the data frame
  long_data <- read_data %>%
    mutate(meth_status = strsplit(meth_pattern, ""), start = strsplit(genom_positions, ",")) %>%
    unnest(meth_status, start) %>%
    mutate(start = as.double(start))

  chr <- unique(read_data$seqnames)
  min_start <- min(read_data$read_start)
  max_end <- max(read_data$read_end)
  
  if(facet_by == "group") {
  plot <- read_data %>%
    ggplot() +
    geom_segment(aes(x = read_start, xend = read_end,
                     y = alpha_jit, yend = alpha_jit, colour = alpha_group)) +
    geom_point(data = long_data,
               aes(x = start, y = alpha_jit,
                   fill = meth_status, colour = alpha_group), shape = 21) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("U" = "white", "M" = "black")) +
    facet_wrap(~ sex, nrow=2) +
    labs(title = paste0(chr, ":", min_start, "-", max_end)) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "genomic position")
  } else if(facet_by == "sample") {
    plot <- read_data %>%
    ggplot() +
    geom_segment(aes(x = read_start, xend = read_end,
                     y = alpha_jit, yend = alpha_jit, colour = alpha_group)) +
    geom_point(data = long_data,
               aes(x = start, y = alpha_jit,
                   fill = meth_status, colour = alpha_group), shape = 21) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("U" = "white", "M" = "black")) +
    facet_wrap(~ sample, nrow=2) +
    labs(title = paste0(chr, ":", min_start, "-", max_end)) +
    theme_bw() +
    labs(x = "genomic position")
  } 
  
  
  plot
}
```

```{r}
geom_beta_sex <- function(all_b, style = "line", plot.space=1, plot.height=1) {
    structure(list(all_b = all_b, style = style, plot.space = plot.space,
        plot.height = plot.height),
        class = "beta_sex"
    )
}

ggplot_add.beta_sex <- function(object, plot, object_name) {
plot2 <- plot
    while (inherits(plot2, "patchwork")) {
        plot2 <- plot2[[1]]
    }
    plot.data <- plot2$labels$title
    plot.data <- stringr::str_split_1(plot.data, ":")
    # prepare plot range
    # the plot region are not normal, so start is minimum value
    plot.chr <- plot.data[1]
    plot.data <- stringr::str_split_1(plot.data[2], "-")
    plot.region.start <- plot.data[1] %>% as.numeric()
    plot.region.end <- plot.data[2] %>% as.numeric()
    
    all_b <- object$all_b
    plot.space <- object$plot.space
    plot.height <- object$plot.height
    style <- object$style
    
 #   all_b <- all_b %>%
#  tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = c(cancer_0223, cancer_0224, cancer_0225, cancer_0454, cancer_0456, cancer_0457, healthy_036, healthy_037, healthy_785, healthy_786, healthy_787, healthy_789), names_to = "sample", values_to = "beta") %>% mutate(type = substr(sample, 1, 1)) %>% filter(seqnames.x %in% plot.chr,
       #                         start.x >= plot.region.start,
      #                          start.x <= plot.region.end)
    all_b <- all_b %>%
    mutate(sex = ifelse(sample %in% c("healthy_036", "healthy_037"), "male", "female"))
    all_b <- all_b %>%
      mutate(type = substr(sample, 1, 1)) %>%
      filter(seqnames %in% plot.chr,
                                start >= plot.region.start,
                                start <= plot.region.end)
    
    if(style == "line") {
      b_plot <- all_b %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = start, y = beta, colour = sex)) +
  geom_line() +
  theme_bw() +
        labs(x = "genomic position")
    } else if (style == "smooth") {
      b_plot <- all_b %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = start, y = beta, colour = sex)) +
        geom_smooth() +
        theme_bw() +
        labs(x = "genomic position")
    }
    else {
    b_plot <- all_b %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = start, y = beta, colour = sex)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
      theme_bw() +
      labs(x = "genomic position")
    }
    
    patchwork::wrap_plots(plot + ggplot2::theme(plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(t = plot.space, b = plot.space)),
        b_plot,
        ncol = 1, heights = c(1, plot.height)
    )
}
```

## read coverage in significant tiles
```{r}
props_sex <- dau_counts %>% filter(gene_id %in% filter(dau_healthy_sex, FDR < 0.05)$region_id) %>% 
  mutate(alpha_group = sub(".*_", "", .$transcript), alpha_group = factor(alpha_group, levels = c("a < 0.2", "0.2 <= a <= 0.4", "0.4 < a < 0.6", "0.6 <= a <= 0.8", "a > 0.8"))) %>%
  mutate(female = rowSums(.[, c("healthy_785", "healthy_786", "healthy_787", "healthy_788", "healthy_789")], na.rm = TRUE),
         male = rowSums(.[, c("healthy_036", "healthy_037")], na.rm = TRUE)) %>% .[,9:12] %>% 
  group_by(gene_id) %>% mutate(female_p = female/sum(female), male_p = male/sum(male)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = c(female, male), names_to = "sex", values_to = "count") %>%
  mutate(percent = ifelse(sex == "female", female_p, male_p)) %>%
  select(-female_p, -male_p) %>%
  ungroup() %>% group_by(gene_id, sex) %>%
  mutate(tile_coverage = sum(count))
```

```{r}
tile_prop <- function(read_data_path_a, read_data_path_b, tiles, cols_from_tiles = NULL) {

  # ── 1. Read only the matching rows — never loads unmatched data into RAM ───
  con <- dbConnect(duckdb())
  duckdb::dbWriteTable(con, "tiles_temp", tiles, overwrite = TRUE)
  on.exit(duckdb::dbRemoveTable(con, "tiles_temp"), add = TRUE)
  
  
  # Build SELECT clause for tile columns
  if (is.null(cols_from_tiles)) {
    # Exclude coordinate cols to avoid clashes with parquet
    tile_cols <- setdiff(colnames(tiles), c("seqnames", "start", "end"))
  } else {
    tile_cols <- cols_from_tiles
  }
  
  tile_select <- if (length(tile_cols) > 0) {
    paste(glue::glue(', t."{tile_cols}"'), collapse = "")
  } else ""
  
  read_data_a <- dbGetQuery(con, glue::glue("
    SELECT b.*{tile_select}
    FROM read_parquet('{read_data_path_a}') b
    JOIN tiles_temp t
      ON b.seqnames = t.seqnames
     AND b.start <= t.end
     AND b.end   >= t.start
  "))
  
  read_data_b <- dbGetQuery(con, glue::glue("
    SELECT b.*{tile_select}
    FROM read_parquet('{read_data_path_b}') b
    JOIN tiles_temp t
      ON b.seqnames = t.seqnames
     AND b.start <= t.end
     AND b.end   >= t.start
  "))
  
  read_data_a <- read_data_a %>% 
  mutate(sample = case_when(sample == "a1" ~ "healthy_785",
                            sample == "a2" ~ "healthy_036",
                            sample == "a3" ~ "healthy_787",
                            sample == "b1" ~ "healthy_786",
                            sample == "b2" ~ "healthy_037",
                            TRUE ~ "healthy_789")) %>%
    mutate(sex = ifelse(sample %in% c("healthy_036", "healthy_037"), "male", "female"))
  read_data_b$sex <- "female"
    read_data <- rbind(read_data_a, read_data_b)
  read_data
}
```

```{r}
rrbs_plot5_sex_df <- function(read_data_path_a, read_data_path_b, chrom, region_start, region_end,
                       jit_amount = 0.1) {
  set.seed(42)

  # ── 1. Read only the matching rows — never loads unmatched data into RAM ───
  con <- dbConnect(duckdb())
  on.exit(dbDisconnect(con))
  
  read_data_a <- dbGetQuery(con, glue::glue("
    SELECT *
    FROM read_parquet('{read_data_path_a}')
    WHERE seqnames = '{chrom}'
      AND \"start\" >= {region_start}
      AND \"end\"   <= {region_end}
  "))
  
  read_data_b <- dbGetQuery(con, glue::glue("
    SELECT *
    FROM read_parquet('{read_data_path_b}')
    WHERE seqnames = '{chrom}'
      AND \"start\" >= {region_start}
      AND \"end\"   <= {region_end}
  "))
  
  read_data_a <- read_data_a %>% 
  mutate(sample = case_when(sample == "a1" ~ "healthy_785",
                            sample == "a2" ~ "healthy_036",
                            sample == "a3" ~ "healthy_787",
                            sample == "b1" ~ "healthy_786",
                            sample == "b2" ~ "healthy_037",
                            TRUE ~ "healthy_789")) %>%
    mutate(sex = ifelse(sample %in% c("healthy_036", "healthy_037"), "male", "female"))
  read_data_b$sex <- "female"
  
  read_data <- rbind(read_data_a, read_data_b)
  
  jitter_amount <- runif(nrow(read_data), -jit_amount, jit_amount)
  read_data$alpha_jit <- read_data$alpha + jitter_amount
  read_data <- data.frame(read_data)
  
  read_data <- read_data %>% mutate(alpha_group = case_when(alpha < 0.2 ~ "a < 0.2",
                                 alpha > 0.8 ~ "a > 0.8",
                                 alpha >= 0.2 & alpha <= 0.4 ~ "0.2 <= a <= 0.4",
                                 alpha > 0.4 & alpha < 0.6 ~ "0.4 < a < 0.6",
                                 TRUE ~ "0.6 <= a <= 0.8"))
  read_data <- read_data %>% mutate(alpha_group = factor(alpha_group, levels = c("a < 0.2", "0.2 <= a <= 0.4", "0.4 < a < 0.6", "0.6 <= a <= 0.8", "a > 0.8")))
  
  # Add jittered coordinates to new columns in the data frame
  long_data <- read_data %>%
    mutate(meth_status = strsplit(meth_pattern, ""), start = strsplit(genom_positions, ",")) %>%
    unnest(meth_status, start) %>%
    mutate(start = as.double(start))
  list(read_data, long_data)
}
```
